# Roblox
> Roblox is a virtual universe where people create, share, and play immersive experiences across devices.

Roblox combines user-generated experiences, social features, a creator platform, developer tools, virtual economy systems, and brand resources. Its ecosystem spans player-facing discovery and account management, creator documentation, API references, talent resources, safety policies, and corporate information.

## Platform
- [Home](https://www.roblox.com/): Main entry point for discovering experiences, friends, and platform features.
- [Discover](https://www.roblox.com/discover): Browse featured, recommended, and trending Roblox experiences.
- [Charts](https://www.roblox.com/charts): View popular and trending experiences across Roblox.
- [Catalog](https://www.roblox.com/catalog): Browse avatar items, accessories, clothing, and marketplace content.
- [Premium](https://www.roblox.com/premium/membership): Learn about Roblox Premium membership benefits and plans.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.roblox.com/giftcards): Purchase and redeem Roblox gift cards and credits.
- [Download](https://www.roblox.com/download): Install Roblox on supported desktop platforms.
- [Mobile Apps](https://www.roblox.com/mobile): Access Roblox mobile app download information.

## Accounts & Support
- [Login](https://www.roblox.com/login): Sign in to a Roblox account.
- [Sign Up](https://www.roblox.com/CreateAccount): Create a new Roblox account.
- [My Settings](https://www.roblox.com/my/settings): Manage account, privacy, security, and billing settings.
- [Transactions](https://www.roblox.com/transactions): Review Robux purchases, sales, and account transaction history.
- [Redeem Roblox Codes](https://www.roblox.com/redeem): Redeem gift cards, promo codes, and credits.
- [Support](https://www.roblox.com/support): Contact Roblox support for account and platform issues.
- [Help Center](https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us): Browse support articles for users, parents, and creators.
- [Quick Login](https://www.roblox.com/login/quick-login): Sign in on another device using quick login.

## Create & Develop
- [Create](https://create.roblox.com/): Central hub for building, publishing, and managing Roblox experiences.
- [Creator Hub](https://create.roblox.com/docs): Official Roblox creator documentation and technical guides.
- [Dashboard](https://create.roblox.com/dashboard): Manage experiences, assets, analytics, and creator settings.
- [Open Cloud](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud): Learn about Roblox Open Cloud APIs and services.
- [Roblox Studio](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio): Get started with Roblox Studio development tools.
- [Publishing Experiences](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/publishing/publishing-experiences-and-places): Publish places and experiences to Roblox.
- [Assets](https://create.roblox.com/docs/art): Learn asset creation workflows for models, audio, images, and UI.
- [Monetization](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/monetization): Explore monetization systems for Roblox experiences.

## Scripting & Engine Docs
- [Scripting](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting): Learn Luau scripting fundamentals for Roblox experiences.
- [Luau](https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau): Reference Luau language usage in Roblox development.
- [Engine API Reference](https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine): Browse classes, enums, properties, and engine members.
- [UI](https://create.roblox.com/docs/ui): Build interfaces for menus, HUDs, and interactive systems.
- [Physics](https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics): Understand simulation, constraints, collisions, and movement systems.
- [Animation](https://create.roblox.com/docs/animation): Create and control character and object animations.
- [Networking](https://create.roblox.com/docs/projects/client-server): Learn Roblox client-server architecture and replication concepts.
- [Performance Optimization](https://create.roblox.com/docs/performance-optimization): Improve experience performance across devices.

## Open Cloud & APIs
- [Open Cloud Overview](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud): Overview of Roblox Open Cloud capabilities and authentication.
- [OpenAPI Reference](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/reference): API reference for Roblox Open Cloud endpoints.
- [Assets API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/assets): Manage asset workflows with Open Cloud APIs.
- [Data Stores API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores): Access and manage persistent data programmatically.
- [Messaging API](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/cross-server-messaging): Send messages across servers and services.
- [Memory Stores](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/memory-stores): Use ephemeral storage for matchmaking and coordination.
- [Webhooks](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/webhooks): Configure webhooks for Roblox cloud integrations.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/auth/oauth2-overview): Implement OAuth for Roblox integrations.
